skills.name: Float32 Casting for SB3 Stability
skills.when_to_use: Gymnasium envs output float64 observations, causing PyTorch autograd instability in SB3
skills.procedure: VecNormalize.load() promotes observations to float64 because its internal stats are float64. CRITICAL: Immediately after loading, cast the stats: vec_env.ob_mean = vec_env.ob_mean.astype(np.float32); vec_env.ob_std = vec_env.ob_std.astype(np.float32). This stops promotion at the source. Keep explicit obs casting before predict as a safety net.
skills.pitfalls: Skipping this causes NaN gradients, policy collapse, and deterministic crash loops regardless of timesteps or architecture
skills.verification: No float64 warnings; training and eval both proceed without gradient explosions or reward drops; episode lengths vary instead of fixing at minimum steps

skills.name: SAC Action Saturation Recovery
skills.when_to_use: Continuous control envs where action_saturation > 0.8 and episodes terminate prematurely with max-thrust/crash behavior
skills.procedure: Reduce learning_rate to 1e-4, ensure ent_coef='auto'. Monitor entropy; if policy saturates, the critic is overconfident in boundary actions. Stabilize updates before scaling timesteps or widening networks.
skills.pitfalls: Increasing timesteps or architecture while saturated only cements the crash policy; always fix LR first
skills.verification: action_saturation drops below 0.5, episode lengths increase beyond minimum steps, entropy stabilizes near target_entropy

skills.name: GPU Enforcement & Buffer Hygiene on HP Shifts
skills.when_to_use: Container has CUDA but VRAM=0, or learning_rate/architecture changes significantly mid-training
skills.procedure: When learning_rate changes by >10x or train_freq/batch_size shifts significantly, unconditionally purge the replay buffer (.pkl) before resuming. Keep model weights and VecNormalize stats for continuity. Stale off-policy data guarantees critic collapse and entropy rebound. Only resume buffers when hyperparameters remain identical to the checkpoint.
skills.pitfalls: Resuming old buffers with new LR causes immediate policy collapse; CPU fallback masks true training speed and wastes wall-clock time
skills.verification: VRAM > 0GB, no timeout on 200k+ steps, reward curve stabilizes/increases post-resume without sudden drops

skills.name: Override Artificial Time Limits for RL Convergence
skills.when_to_use: Episodes terminate prematurely due to env.spec.max_episode_steps being too short for policy learning (e.g., 4 steps)
skills.procedure: Gymnasium auto-wraps with TimeLimit using registry specs. To override: unwrap first then re-wrap (env = gym.wrappers.TimeLimit(gym.make('hover-aviary-v0').unwrapped, max_episode_steps=1000)), or pass max_episode_steps=1000 directly to gym.make(). Nesting TimeLimits causes the inner default to trigger first.
skills.pitfalls: Training on artificially short episodes causes reward collapse and prevents credit assignment; never accept default time limits blindly
skills.verification: Episode lengths exceed previous caps; info dict no longer shows TimeLimit.truncated at step 4; reward curve begins to climb

skills.name: Explicit CUDA Enforcement & TimeLimit Override
skills.when_to_use: Container has CUDA but VRAM=0, or env.spec.max_episode_steps modification fails post-gym.make
skills.procedure: Force device='cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available(). Wrap base env with gym.wrappers.TimeLimit(env, max_episode_steps=1000) immediately after gym.make() to bypass baked-in TimeLimit wrappers.
skills.pitfalls: device='auto' silently falls back to CPU in some SB3 versions; modifying spec.post-make is ignored by Gymnasium's wrapper chain
skills.verification: VRAM > 0GB, episodes exceed previous step caps, training speed increases significantly

skills.name: Bypass Hardcoded Environment Time Limits
skills.when_to_use: Episodes truncate at fixed steps despite gym.make(max_episode_steps=X) or registry overrides, indicating internal env enforcement
skills.procedure: Wrap base env with a custom HorizonOverride class that tracks step_count in step(), forces truncated=False and info['TimeLimit.truncated']=False until desired limit, then yields control. Apply before observation/action wrappers.
skills.pitfalls: Gymnasium's TimeLimit wrapper passes through inner env truncation flags; kwarg overrides fail against hardcoded __init__ limits
skills.verification: Episode lengths exceed previous caps; info dict no longer shows early truncation; reward curve begins climbing past noise floor
